features_and_traits: When you finish a Short Rest, you can recover expended spell slots. The spell slots can have a combined level equal to no more than 1, and none of the slots can be level 6 or higher.
You can use this feature once per Long Rest.
Your Size is Medium or Small, chosen when you select this species.
You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.
You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.
You gain an Origin feat of your choice.
When you take this feat, your HP maximum increases by 2. Whenever you gain a character level thereafter, your HP maximum increases an additional 2 HP.
You gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice.
Repeatable. You can take this feat more than once.
